description: Lists the connected account's live Carryo websites and private drafts, with titles, linkIds, live links, status, and effective edit and inactivity policies. Suitable for finding a website by name. Returns Personal websites by default; workspaceId selects the user-chosen team's collection.

workspaceId.description: Optional exact workspaceId of the Carryo team selected by the user. Lists Personal websites when omitted.

name: website.list

artifacts.description: Carryo pages owned by the authenticated user

accessMode.description: Whether the page is public or restricted

isRevoked.description: Whether the share link has been revoked

manageUrl.description: Carryo management URL for private drafts

policies.description: Actual per-website policy; use this instead of Personal account defaults

canReactivate.description: Whether restoration is currently supported in Carryo, subject to available capacity

inactivityRevokesAt.description: Inactivity deadline; a separately set expiresAt can take the website offline earlier

inactivityWindowDays.description: Days since this website’s last owner edit or Keep live action; null means no inactivity expiry. Views and sign-in do not renew it

updatesPerLink.description: This website’s update limit; null means unlimited subject to fair use

publicationState.description: Whether the page is a private draft or published

shareUrl.description: Primary share URL, omitted for private drafts

limit.description: Pagination limit used by the response

offset.description: Pagination offset used by the response

workspaceId.description: Workspace whose links were listed; omitted for Personal

title: List My Websites
